subject: general
question: What is the meaning of the term Moraine?

options.text: Material transported and deposited by glacier
Valley with vertical sides and wide floor

solution:
The correct answer is glacial activity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Glaciers are a mass of ice moving under its own weight. They are commonly found in the snow fields.
 
• Glacial deposits are of two types:
 
 
• Glacial Till - unassorted coarse and fine debris
 
• Outwash - assorted roughly stratified deposits.
 
 
 
• A moraine is a major depositional landform that is commonly found on gentle slopes.
 
• Moraines are long ridges of deposits of glacial till.
